findings.desc: CHK-001:adversarial:1 evidence-to-intent mismatch: the intent states the scenario is "root package.json is read-only (chmod 0444) throws with a clear error and does not partially update the other 2 files", but the smoke (version-bump-smoke.ts section 13, line 144) makes the BRAND file (lattice-brand.ts) read-only, not root package.json. The write order in applyPatchBump is rootPackageJson -> mainPackageJson -> brand; making the brand read-only exercises a harder rollback (2 files already written when 3rd fails), while making root read-only is an earlier-fail scenario (0 files written when 1st fails). The two scenarios have different atomicity properties. The evidence note in the verificationEvidence record repeats the intent description verbatim, so the note claims root package.json was tested when the smoke actually used the brand file. The evidence command (node packages/main/dist/tasks/version-bump-smoke.js) does not match the specific scenario described in CHK-001:adversarial:1.

misleading-test: version-bump-smoke.ts:139-141 test 12 name claims whitespace around brand literal still parses but only exercises readSyncedVersion (read path); applyPatchBump replaceOnce uses a fixed-format needle LATTICE_CLI_VERSION = (single space, no padding) which would fail to match the whitespace-padded form tested, leaving a latent write-path failure undiscovered by the test

dead-export: version-bump.ts:51 formatSemver is exported but never imported by any external caller; it is only used internally by nextPatch on line 58. Exporting an internal helper unnecessarily widens the module API surface.

CHK-001:happy:4 intent states the success line returned by bumpVersionOnDoneMerge must contain the literal word "auto-bumped", but the smoke only asserts line6.includes("0.9.9") && line6.includes("0.9.10"). If the return string were changed to omit "auto-bumped" (e.g. "✓ version bumped 0.9.9 → 0.9.10") the smoke would still pass. The word "auto-bumped" is the operator-visible signal that the automation (not a manual bump) fired; the smoke should add a check("bump line contains auto-bumped", line6.includes("auto-bumped")) assertion to fully bind the intent.
